The sentences may be broken into sections and repeated if the child forgets some of the words. Underline any mispronounced words and fill in the total number of mispronounced words at the end of each sentence. Put 0 in box if no words are mispronounced. If the child refuses to respond to a particular sentence write NT in that box.::Enter number of mispronounced words::The shop has run out of strawberry flavoured ice cream
